mirror-runtime.does: Writes manifest.json from the overlay, fetches every pinned file from https://next.facemorph.me/runtime/<path> (or copies it from runtime-overlay/), checks size and sha256, follows pinned nested manifests, copies the photo worker siblings from photo-runtime/ checked against the photo manifest's sources, copies hosting/next/notices/ to notices/, removes stale files, and fails closed on any mismatch. single-file.does: Fetches one pinned file and checks its digest; a chunked asset is fetched as its chunks.
